watch.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable after missing Week 11; 40-year-old Josh Johnson started the 34-7 loss at Kansas City. Gardner Minshew had UCL surgery.
The Cardinals fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin takes over on an interim basis.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) has a possible Week 16 return; Jacoby Brissett started Weeks 10-11, both losses, and the Ravens have lost six straight.
CB Marlon Humphrey was a healthy scratch in the 35-33 loss at Carolina; the Ravens are noncommittal on him for Houston.
CB Christian Benford (groin) is questionable after a limited walkthrough Tuesday; TE Dalton Kincaid and G O'Cyrus Torrence were limited, RT Spencer Brown full.
G Brady Christensen (hamstring) reverted to season-ending injured reserve Tuesday when his practice window closed.
S Elijah Hicks (concussion) is ruled out for Thanksgiving and CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder), who missed Week 11, is questionable; OT Theo Benedet is back to full practice.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is doubtful and G Tyler Booker (ankle) is out for Thanksgiving; CB DaRon Bland is on IR.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), on IR and designated to return, practiced fully on Monday's estimated report.
RB J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Friday's game at Pittsburgh (conduct detrimental to the team).
DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL, season) and LB Jack Campbell are on IR and rookie DT Skyler Gill-Howard needs season-ending knee surgery; our ratings include games with them.
S Chuck Clark was limited Tuesday and CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. and edge DJ Wonnum are questionable for Thanksgiving vs. Chicago.
CB D.J. Reed (hip), out the last three games, practiced fully Monday; S Kerby Joseph made his season debut in Week 11.
Edge Micah Parsons, activated from PUP, is questionable but expected to make his season debut tonight at the Rams; our ratings were built without him.
RB Josh Jacobs (broken ring finger, sat out the Week 10 loss to Minnesota) is questionable; LaFleur said Tuesday he is unlikely to play. Inactives come about 90 min before kickoff.
LB Azeez Al-Shaair is on IR after groin surgery and DE Chris Braswell (knee, Nov. 19) is out for the season; DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.
The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson Sr. makes his first start of the season.
Both starting OTs and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward missed Week 11 and are questionable; WR Alec Pierce is shut down for the season.
OT Walker Little (knee) left the 23-18 loss to the Giants, C Robert Hainsey is questionable and RT Anton Harrison is on IR.
OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) still wasn't practicing Tuesday and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) was limited; both missed Week 11.
G Trey Smith (concussion), who missed Week 11, was a full participant Monday.
WR Puka Nacua (MCL surgery) is out 4-5 months and WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is likelier back mid-December.
G Steve Avila and C Coleman Shelton (hamstrings) are ruled out tonight on the Rams' final report; TE Terrance Ferguson needs season-ending ankle surgery.
DT Kobie Turner (groin) is being activated from IR with no designation after full practices all week.
QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol after the 27-24 loss to the Jets; DJ Uiagalelei is next up if he can't clear it.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza has started Weeks 10-11 since Kirk Cousins was traded; most of our ratings were built with Cousins.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11 and is questionable for Sunday night at Cleveland.
QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11, including the 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
The defensive line has lost several players for the season, most recently DT Jordan Phillips (torn biceps).
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Weeks 9-11 and is questionable; Kirk Cousins, who started Weeks 10-11, stays the starter. WR Jordan Addison is not expected to play.
QB Drake Maye (fractured right fibula, Week 10) is out; Tommy DeVito stays QB1 per Mike Vrabel, but our ratings were built with Maye.
G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) was designated to return from IR Monday.
OL: OT Asim Richards (doubtful), OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy (questionable) all sat the last two games; S Justin Reid was released.
CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) went on injured reserve Tuesday.
RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring, IR) could be reinstated when first eligible, ahead of the Week 13 game vs. San Francisco.
QB Geno Smith returned from his ankle injury for the 27-24 win at the Chargers; Cade Klubnik played much of the Week 10 loss to Buffalo.
Jalen Hurts is on IR; Tanner McKee started Weeks 7-8 and Joe Milton Weeks 9 and 11. Our ratings carry early-season games with Hurts.
CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was limited Tuesday and edge Arnold Ebiketie did not practice; LB Zack Baun is on IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returned in the Week 11 win over Pittsburgh and practiced fully Monday.
The Steelers benched QB Aaron Rodgers after two straight losses (38-18 at CIN, 19-16 at PHI); Mason Rudolph starts Friday. Our ratings were built on Rodgers' starts.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) is listed doubtful for Friday and LB Nick Herbig (hip) was limited Tuesday.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) practiced fully Tuesday and is expected back vs. Denver after missing three games.
QB Sam Darnold, who missed Weeks 9-10 (Drew Lock started) before the bye, is set to start at San Francisco if practice goes well.
G Quenton Nelson is doubtful and LT Charles Cross questionable for Sunday.
RT Colton McKivitz fractured and dislocated his ankle vs. Minnesota and is likely out for the season; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is still hurting.
CBs Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is questionable.
QB Baker Mayfield is playing through plantar fasciitis and started the 31-21 loss at Detroit.
Three OL starters are on IR (Peter Skoronski, Jackson Slater, Fernando Carmona) and RB Tyjae Spears joined them.

2026_12_BAL_HOU.summary: The market already priced Lamar Jackson's absence and stops at Houston -6.5; our ratings lean harder on Baltimore's six straight losses, and Houston's defense is banged up.

reasons.text: Baltimore has lost six straight (4-7), the last two with Jacoby Brissett at QB while Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) is out until Week 16 at the earliest.
Houston's front seven is thin: LB Azeez Al-Shaair is on IR, DE Chris Braswell is out for the season and DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.
The line opened Houston -5.5 and has moved to -7, toward our number but well short of it.

swings.HOU: Houston's 26-3 win over Indianapolis (Nov. 19) lifted our rating more than the market moved; the market has Houston -7 vs. a Ravens team on backup QB Jacoby Brissett.
swings.BAL: Baltimore's sixth straight loss (35-33 at Carolina, Nov. 22) with Brissett dropped our rating further, while the market, which already priced Jackson's absence, moved only from Houston -5.5 to -6.5.

2026_12_ATL_MIN.summary: The market keeps Minnesota -7 against a 3-7 Atlanta team that has lost five of six with shaky QB play; our ratings marked the Vikings down more after their 35-10 loss at San Francisco.

reasons.text: Atlanta is 3-7, has lost three straight (0-16 at TB, 17-34 vs CIN, 13-35 vs KC) and comes off its Week 11 bye; reviews cite unreliable QB play from Michael Penix Jr.
FanDuel opened Atlanta +6.5; the preview points to Minnesota's blitz-heavy defense against an Atlanta offense that has struggled vs. the blitz.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring, out Weeks 9-11) is questionable, but Kevin O'Connell says Kirk Cousins stays the starter; WR Jordan Addison (thumb) is not expected to play.

swings.MIN: Minnesota's 35-10 loss at San Francisco (Week 11) cut our rating by several points, but the market opened the Vikings -6.5 vs. Atlanta anyway and has moved to -7.
swings.ATL: Nothing new on Atlanta over its Week 11 bye: the swing comes from Minnesota's 35-10 loss at San Francisco lowering our Vikings rating while the market stayed at Vikings -6.5 to -7.
